metas.name: Enna Vilai
metas.description: A humble fisherman from Rameswaram lives a quiet life with his family until he finds a gold pendant washed ashore. What initially seems like a blessing soon turns into a nightmare when false accusations threaten his peace and dignity, forcing him to stand up against a powerful system.

metas.name: Modha Rathiri
metas.description: Follows two strangers brought together at an unusual wedding where, in one night, too many surprises unfold and several lies are told, spiraling into chaos that changes everything.

metas.name: Interstellar
metas.description: In a dystopian future where Earth has become near-uninhabitable, a team of astronauts embark on a mission to find a new home for humanity.

metas.name: The Matrix
metas.description: A computer hacker discovers that his life is nothing more than an elaborate simulation run by an evil AI.

metas.name: 12th Fail
metas.description: The real-life story of IPS Officer Manoj Kumar Sharma and IRS Officer Shraddha Joshi.

metas.name: Jersey
metas.description: A failed cricketer decides to revive his cricketing career in his late 30's despite everyone being skeptical of his ability to do so.

metas.name: Hushar Pittalu
metas.description: In a village, two teenagers fall into a secret relationship, driven by curiosity and bad influences. As their families oppose them, the couple rebels, exposing how youthful attraction and parental mistakes can change lives forever.

metas.name: Alai Payuthey
metas.description: After a difficult romance in a class-divided society, the love birds find out marriage is not what they thought it would be.

metas.name: Sonar Kella
metas.description: A young boy becomes a target for crooks, after he claims to remember his past life and mentions precious jewels in a golden fortress.

metas.name: Dhurandhar
metas.description: A mysterious traveler slips into the heart of Karachi's underbelly and rises through its ranks with lethal precision, only to tear the notorious ISI-Underworld nexus apart from within.

metas.name: Drishyam 2
metas.description: Seven years after burying a dark secret, a cinema owner and his family face a renewed investigation led by a relentless new inspector and a grieving mother. New witnesses and forensic traps threaten to shatter their peaceful life.

metas.name: Manjummel Boys
metas.description: A group of friends get into a daring rescue mission to save their friend from Guna Caves, a perilously deep pit from where nobody has ever been brought back.

metas.name: The Wolf of Wall Street
metas.description: Based on the true story of Jordan Belfort, from his rise to a wealthy stock-broker living the high life to his fall involving crime, corruption and the federal government.

metas.name: Dia
metas.description: Dia takes three years to confess her feelings to Rohith but after a terrible accident, she is told he does not survive. Later, when she starts seeing Adi, she finds out that Rohith is still alive.

metas.name: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
metas.description: A forgotten Peter Parker lives alone as a full-time Spider-Man until mounting pressure triggers a dangerous change and a powerful new enemy emerges.

metas.name: Omkara
metas.description: A politically-minded enforcer's misguided trust in his lieutenant leads him to suspect his wife of infidelity in this adaptation of Shakespeare's 'Othello'.

metas.name: Kaakha Kaakha
metas.description: After a police team kills his brother, a drug-dealing gangster vows to kill the entire team and their respective families.

metas.name: Titanic
metas.description: A young aristocrat falls in love with a poor artist aboard the luxurious, ill-fated RMS Titanic.

metas.name: Gulaal
metas.description: A law student witnesses deception, homicide, and crime after being elected as General Secretary of his college.

metas.name: Baby
metas.description: An elite counter-intelligence unit learns of a plot, masterminded by a maniacal madman. With the clock ticking, it's up to them to track the terrorists' international tentacles and prevent them from striking at the heart of India.

metas.name: E.T. the Extra-Terrestrial
metas.description: A troubled child summons the courage to help a friendly alien escape from Earth and return to his home planet.

metas.name: Gully Boy
metas.description: A coming-of-age story based on the lives of street rappers in Mumbai.

metas.name: Ghostbusters
metas.description: Armed with proton packs, four paranormal investigators battle mischievous ghouls in New York.

metas.name: Obsession
metas.description: After breaking the mysterious "One Wish Willow" to win his crush's heart, a hopeless romantic finds himself getting exactly what he asked for but soon discovers that some desires come at a dark, sinister price.

metas.name: RRR
metas.description: A fearless warrior on a perilous mission comes face to face with a steely cop serving British forces in this epic saga set in pre-independent India.

metas.name: Tenzing
metas.description: The untold and inspiring tale of one of the most important mountain climbers in history who, with Edmund Hillary, became the first person to reach the summit of Mount Everest.

metas.name: Gulmohar
metas.description: Follows the final four days of the Batra family living in their 31-year-old family home as they move to a new city.

metas.name: Neerja
metas.description: The story of courageous Neerja Bhanot, who sacrificed her life while protecting the lives of 359 passengers on Pan Am Flight 73 in 1986 when it was hijacked by a terrorist organization.

metas.name: Court
metas.description: When an aging activist is arrested, the lives of the accused, the lawyers, and the judge intertwine to reveal bigotry that underscores the judicial system.

metas.name: Pokkiri
metas.description: Thamizh is a killer for hire with no ties and who will do any dirty job for money. He has a girlfriend who loves him but also detests his violent nature. But is Thamizh really what he purports to be?

metas.name: Ante Sundharaniki
metas.description: A Hindu Brahmin falls for a Christian girl and they both lie to their parents, only for their lies to be revealed.

metas.name: Sinners
metas.description: Trying to leave their troubled lives behind, twin brothers return to their hometown to start again, only to discover that an even greater evil is waiting to welcome them back.

metas.name: A Nightmare on Elm Street
metas.description: Teenager Nancy Thompson must uncover the dark truth concealed by her parents after she and her friends become targets of the spirit of a serial killer with a bladed glove in their dreams, in which if they die, it kills them in rea...

metas.name: Toy Story 5
metas.description: Woody, Buzz, Jessie and the rest of the gang's jobs are challenged when they're introduced to electronics, a new threat to playtime.

metas.name: Khuda Haafiz: Chapter 2 - Agni Pariksha
metas.description: Sameer and Nargis, after overcoming all odds, find a ray of sunshine when little Nandini enters their lives and their family is complete; But their happiness is short-lived. In a bizarre twist of fate, Nandini goes missing.

metas.name: Corpse Bride
metas.description: When a shy groom practices his wedding vows in the inadvertent presence of a deceased young woman, she rises from the grave assuming he has married her.

metas.name: Shaurya
metas.description: Maj. Siddhant Chaudhary, an Indian Army lawyer, attempts to defend Capt. Javed Khan who is accused of killing a decorated officer. The problem is that Khan does not wish to be defended and freely admits to his crime.

metas.name: Billa
metas.description: A cop chases international gangster Billa and happens to be the only one to see him die. He places Velu, Billa's lookalike, inside the gang to get information. But Velu is framed for killing the cop.

metas.name: Ek Chalis Ki Last Local
metas.description: A comic thriller about two people who miss the last local train at 1:40 am and how missing of their train changes their course of life forever.

metas.name: Taxi No. 9 2 11: Nau Do Gyarah
metas.description: A cabbie (Patekar) and businessman (Abraham) both in need of big money partake in a two-hour adventure together.

metas.name: Kolamavu Kokila
metas.description: To save her mother from terminal cancer, a young girl gets herself involved with the drug trafficking mafia active in the small towns of Tamil Nadu.

metas.name: Gremlins
metas.description: After receiving an exotic small animal as a Christmas gift, a young man inadvertently breaks three important rules concerning his new pet, which unleashes a horde of malevolently mischievous creatures on a small town.

metas.name: Jailer
metas.description: A retired jailer goes on a manhunt to find his son's killers. But the road leads him to a familiar, albeit a bit darker place. Can he emerge from this complex situation successfully?

metas.name: Vishwanath and Sons
metas.description: Sanjay Vishwanath has devoted decades to excellence as an international shooter. When age, family duties, and an unexpected romance collide with his ambitions, he must confront what truly makes a life worth living.

metas.name: Bring Her Back
metas.description: A brother and sister uncover a terrifying ritual at the secluded home of their new foster mother.

metas.name: Vikram Vedha
metas.description: A tough police officer sets out to track down and kill an equally tough gangster.

metas.name: Padmaavat
metas.description: Set in medieval Rajasthan, Queen Padmavati is married to a noble king and they live in a prosperous fortress with their subjects until an ambitious Sultan hears of Padmavati's beauty and forms an obsessive love for the Queen of Me...

metas.name: IB 71
metas.description: A spy action thriller about the two-front war between Indian intelligence agencies and the Pakistani establishment in 1971.

metas.name: Hotel Transylvania
metas.description: Dracula, who operates a high-end resort away from the human world, goes into overprotective mode when a boy discovers the resort and falls for the count's teenaged daughter.

metas.name: Dressed to Kill
metas.description: A mysterious blonde woman kills one of the patients of a psychiatrist and then goes after the high-class hooker who witnessed the murder.
